resolution.strategy: Replace the Maven/Javac-only database acceptance path with an equally strict executable Python PostgreSQL gate.
resolution.database_execution: The exact test must require HHY_DB_SMOKE_CONFIRM=YES, connect to disposable PostgreSQL 17, execute empty and upgrade migrations through V048, and execute database/tests/r15_notification_support_invariants.sql.
mandatory_invariants: ticket message idempotency identity is immutable
new writes cannot set the legacy idempotency bypass flag
